purpose: Environment-only corrective qualification of complete-system repeatability for the minimally seeded original M-TARE baseline.

approval.scope: One immutable V2 run; only add catkin --extend environment composition. Tunnel, original M-TARE, seeds 11/11/23, 60 simulation seconds per trial, 300 audited frames and 60 waypoints remain unchanged. No model inference, training, method comparison, C09 or C10.
approval.confirmation_reference: After V1 failure, the exact V2 environment-only correction and unchanged three-trial contract were presented; the user replied '批准'.

raw_sources: AEE tunnel development simulator world and original M-TARE planner-seed runnable image sha256:5cbede29e4229e92d85ebaf919be2fb9ebc4ad9ed97029b7639997779062748c.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local reproducibility qualification of the existing research baseline.

strict_test: All formal benchmark/test worlds and C10 are forbidden

sampling.rule: Retain all ROS messages; compare exactly the first 100 scan-synchronous scan/pose pairs and first 20 waypoints from each of three trials.

teacher.source: No teacher, learned model or oracle is read.
teacher.valid_mask: All frozen required ROS topics must be present, type-correct and nonempty.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Seed-11 repeats must be exactly equal in frame rows and waypoints; seed 23 must change the observed scan/trajectory sequence.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Infrastructure repeatability qualification only; no learning, selection, calibration or performance estimate.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU plus Gazebo, three serial 60-second trials; zero GPU, training, optimization or learned-model inference.

evidence.machine_metrics: Three bags, 300 frame rows, 60 waypoints, topic audits, exact comparison, logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Exact reproducibility is evaluated numerically; complete raw bags are retained.
evidence.failure_policy: Any drift, startup failure, insufficient evidence, same-seed mismatch or missing different-seed variation is sealed FAIL with no retry.
